notes.title: New Game Announcement!!
notes.notes:
We just announced our brand new disc golf game: Disc Golf Masters – coming first to Steam Early Access.

Built for PC and consoles, Disc Golf Masters takes everything we’ve learned from Disc Golf Valley and creates a whole new experience:
[list]
[*] Updated throwing mechanics
[*] Reworked disc physics
[*] Career mode
[*] Online multiplayer
[*] New courses
[*] Discs and brands from the House of Discs family (Latitude 64, Dynamic Discs, Discmania, Kastaplast, Westside.)
[/list]
This is not an update or remake – it’s a completely new game, built for modern platforms.

Wishlist now!!!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819400/Disc_Golf_Masters/

notes.title: 1.522 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:
Daily Challenge now gives the correct amount of Season points.
Players should now gets a level up reward from level up every time.
Out of Bounds in water no longer teleports to the edge of map.
Season 9 end rewards weren't properly distributed to all players. They will be given retroactively to players who haven't already received it.
Putting Practice no longer freezes the game.
Miscellaneous other bug fixes.

* Buffs to Sticky, Wind Break, and Water Skip.
* Significant optimization of disc collection.
* You can now reconnect to Events if you crashed.
* Summary Screen rework.
* You can now earn Foiled discs from random disc rewards.
* Miscellaneous bug fixes and more.

We have added Maple Hill 2024, get ready to play along with the major events going on on the real-life course, in Disc Golf Valley!

Plus:
-Season Points gift to all
-Miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: The Haunted Valley
notes.notes:
We are hosting a Halloween-themed event in October. It is open to everyone. To participate click the “Events” button in the main menu. 

There is a unique disc reward for those in the top 50 positions. Don’t worry, there is also a special participation reward for everyone that participates, no matter your final result.

[b]Dare to join the fun![/b]
